title: Chapter 268 Lu Xue'S Retreat
content:
Chapter 268 Lu Xue'S Retreat

On the other side, inside Zhuyun Peak.

"Here, this is where we stay in the academy."

Lu Xue pulled Yuanyuan back to Zhuyun Peak and introduced Zhuyun Peak to Yuanyuan.

Upon hearing this, Yuanyuan also looked around.

"Sister Xue, where is Xiao Luo?"

Xiao Luo?

Lu Xue was slightly stunned, and then she remembered that Xiao Luo had not come back together.

"Oh, what do you care about him? In the academy, you can still lose him, don't worry about him."

Lu Xue waved her hand, not caring about it.

Seeing this, Yuanyuan didn't say anything.

At this time, a sweeper from Zhuyun Peak came over from a distance.

"I've met Miss Lu."

"You came just right, this is Yuanyuan. From now on, like me, you will be a member of Zhuyun Peak."

Hearing this, the sweeper immediately bowed to Yuanyuan beside Lu Xue.

"I've seen Miss Round."

"By the way, Sister Yin, why didn't you see her?"

Lu Xue suddenly remembered that she had been back for so long, why hadn't seen Xiao Yin before, and then asked.

"Miss Lu, you don't know yet, Teacher Xiao, she's going to play the Immortal Emperor List."

When he said this, the servant had a hint of admiration in his eyes.

The Immortal Emperor List is a height that ordinary people will never reach in their lifetime.

Of course, let alone playing the Immortal Emperor List, even if you can reach the Immortal Emperor Realm, countless people will be proud.

And this guy is obviously one of them.

Although he is in a transcendent force like Tiandi Academy, being able to become a formal student in this life is the ultimate wish of people like him.

When Lu Xue heard the servant's words, she was slightly stunned.

"The Immortal Emperor List?"

Lu Xue murmured to herself.

She only has a rough understanding of Xiao Yin's strength.

She naturally knew about the list of Immortal Emperors.

There are ten places on the list.

Theoretically, the strongest ones who can be on the list of Immortal Emperors are the ten most powerful Immortal Emperors in the entire Immortal Emperor Realm.

It is not ruled out that some strong people do not want to show up and expose their strength.

But the value of the Immortal Emperor List is unquestionable.

"Sister Yin is so powerful."

"Then are there any results now?"

Lu Xue asked.

Hearing this, the servant shook his head.

"I don't know this young man."

"Okay, please give me a trouble."

"Please."

Lu Xue pulled Yuanyuan and said, "Help me clean up the yard next to my place and use it as a residence for Yuanyuan."

In response to this, the servant said directly, "Young Master, go now."

Immediately, the servant threw down the broom in his hand and ran towards Zhuyun Peak with a mercy.

On the spot, Lu Xue smiled at Yuanyuan and said, "Live next to me, no problem, right?"

Hearing this, Yuanyuan shook her head, "Of course not."

"Then let's go."

Lu Xue is still optimistic about this disciple of Shi Liantian.

Although she does not have the superb alchemy skills as Shi Liantian, as an apprentice, she should not be much worse.

Nowadays, Yuanyuan's cultivation is in the late stage of the Immortal Lord realm, which is one level higher than her.

If you have time, you should still have a good understanding of Yuanyuan's alchemy level.

Thinking of this in my heart, Lu Xue had already taken Yuanyuan back to her residence.

"Two girls, the residence has been cleaned up."

As soon as he arrived at the door, the servant suddenly ran out, and a servant popped up next to him at some point.

"So fast?"

Lu Xue's mouth opened slightly, looking surprised.

He looked up at the yard.

The small courtyard is spotless.

"That's right, that's right, Xiaosheng did this."

The servant responded with a proud smile on his face.

This is called professionalism.

Soon, Lu Xue took Yuanyuan in and visited.

With Yuanyuan's personality, naturally he didn't say anything.

"You will live here in the future. If you have any questions, look for Xiao Luo. If Xiao Luo doesn't work, look for a tutor."

Lu Xue looked at Yuanyuan.

Hearing this, Yuanyuan said blankly, "Where are you, Sister Xue?"

"I?"

Lu Xue's face turned slightly red, "Well, that's the matter, I'm going to stay in seclusion for a while. It's nothing. Try not to bother me unless the end of the world is over."

"Oh, OK, okay, I won't say much. You can get to know this here yourself. Just find the sweeper if you lack something."

"Go away."

Lu Xue waved her hand and then ran back to her residence.

Standing there, looking at Lu Xue's departure back, Yuanyuan shook her head slightly.

Why did I suddenly feel that it is so unreliable to come out with Lu Xue to save the fairy world?

I looked at the room behind me and it was very unique.

After a moment of silence, Yuanyuan took out a cauldron of alchemy.

After a moment, the fragrance of medicine floated out of the courtyard and echoed throughout Zhuyun Peak.

After Lu Xue returned to her residence, she set up a warning formation, which was to raise her foot and enter the retreat cultivation room.

"Huh, next, you will not leave the level until the peak of the Immortal Lord's realm!"

Just as he sat down cross-legged, Lu Xue set a goal for herself.

As if he had thought of something, Lu Xue took out a blue dragon egg.

Looking at the dragon egg in front of him, which was almost the same as a human head, Lu Xue frowned slightly.

"Xiaoqing, when will you come out?"

The sound rang out from the practice room, but Longdan did not respond at all.

"Xiaoqing?"

Lu Xue didn't believe it, evil spoke again.

The dragon egg still didn't respond.

At this moment, Lu Xue frowned even deeper.

"Xiaoqing, you won't die inside, are you?"

Lu Xue shook her head slightly, then placed the dragon egg beside her and slowly closed her eyes.

At the same time, the Weiwei Fairy Qi flowed from around Lu Xue to echo.

After a moment, a small storm formed, and Lu Xue was in the center of the storm.

If such a practice scene is seen by outsiders, it will inevitably be shocked.

A natural spiritual body, a rare genius in cultivation!

......

There is no time to practice, and soon, a year has passed.

In the dim training room, Lu Xue slowly opened her eyes, with a hint of turbidity in her eyes, but it immediately became clear.

"Huh~ It feels pretty good."

He slowly clenched his fists, feeling the increasing strength in his body, Lu Xue showed a sweet smile.

Early stage of the Immortal Lord Realm!

Looking at the entire fairy world, this speed is absolutely terrifying.

But this is not the fastest.

Because Lu Xue did not give full play.

To be promoted to the Immortal Lord Realm, it is better to take a steady step.

Turning his head and looking at the dragon egg beside him.

Still no response.

Seeing this, Lu Xue took out a large number of purple crystal stones from the ring, and soon filled the entire cultivation room.

This crystal is currently the main cultivation resource used by Lu Xue.

Although she no longer relies on her parents, the money she had plundered from Lu Daosheng was enough to be rich enough to rival a country.

Looking at the entire fairy world, Lu Xue is the second most in terms of resources, and no one dares to be the first.

Even those alchemy masters who are behind the foundation dare not touch the porcelain.

After a moment of silence, Lu Xue took out several scrolls and placed them in front of her.

These are all martial arts and martial arts brought by Lu Xue from the deserted city.

Powerful martial arts can greatly improve a person's strength.

Similarly, those alchemists want to refine good elixirs rely on advanced alchemy methods.

At this moment, Lu Xue looked at several high-level martial arts in front of her, but she felt a little troubled.

A large part of these are peerless martial arts that have been lost in the fairy world.

Once any book is leaked, it will be enough to cause a huge wave in the fairy world.

But at this moment, Lu Xue showed a disgusting look.

Practicing these martial arts requires a lot of energy and time.

Once upon a time, Lu Xue was too lazy to do these things. She had no need to fight with her if she had strong combat power.

But now, everything is different.

"Oh, in a while, when my Immortal Lord's realm reaches its peak, I will definitely practice."

In the end, Lu Xue decided to wait until she left the seclusion before she could understand these martial arts and martial arts well.

Although she can practice now, she is still a bit reluctant.

After she reaches the peak of the Immortal Lord Realm, it will be much easier.

Lu Xue touched the dragon egg beside her, then closed her eyes and started practicing again.
